coreBackstory: Kael was the royal blacksmith before a disagreement with a noble cost him his position. He chose exile over apology.
greetings: If you're here to browse, browse elsewhere. If you're here to buy, we'll talk.
Don't touch the finished blades. The oils on your fingers ruin the temper.
You look like you need a weapon. Or a better one. Either way, you came to the right forge.
idleChatter: Good steel doesn't lie. It tells you what it wants to be. You just have to listen.
I made a sword for a knight once. He used it to defend a village. That's the job — make things that matter.
The ore from the northern mines is impure. I have to work twice as hard for half the result.
Adventurers break weapons like they're made of glass. I make tools, not toys.
farewells: Take care of your blade, and it'll take care of you. Neglect it, and you're on your own.
Come back when you have better ore. I'll make something worth carrying.
And stay out of my scrap bin. Last person who went through it is still missing fingers.
reactiveComments: That edge is ruined. Bring it to me. I can fix it — for a price.
You fight like you're afraid of your own weapon. Confidence is half the battle.
I've been working on something new. Experimental. You look like you need an advantage.
